title: Coral and the Harbor
author: Quentin Ashgrove
blurb: Freya Ashgrove, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
